seed_ledger.name: Nueva Era Dos Pipeline Project
seed_ledger.reason: No data center tie. FERC docket CP25-527 (applicant Nueva Era Dos LLC, filed July 2025): 3,603 ft of 36-inch border crossing by horizontal directional drill, Maverick County TX to Coahuila, about 1 Bcf/d to unnamed Mexican industrial customers, $8.4 million. Separate crossing from the Webb County Nueva Era line (P0290), so it could take its own row later, but power or industrial demand alone under 25 km stays monitor. Search budget ran out after 2 searches. Searches run: 2. Sources: Federal Register notice 2025-20661 (confirms project scope), policyrisk Federal Register summaries (no data center named), EIA Aug 2026 workbook row 93 (power and industrial demand only). Not reached: state regulator, air permit, utility, county, trade press for a Coahuila data center tie.

seed_ledger.name: ABI-1 Electric Generating Unit power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE (supplier probably Energy Transfer Oasis, route not found). TCEQ pending air permit 182467 for VoltaGrid ABI-1 at 299 FM 604, Shackelford County, says the plant serves the nearby data center campus and that gas heaters warm fuel gas after dropping pressure from the nearby pipeline, which describes an on-site tap on an existing line with no new pipe. A VoltaGrid and Oracle announcement says Energy Transfer's Oasis Pipeline gives firm gas. Cleanview repeats the Oasis supplier and says no grid tie. No source gives a lateral, route or length. The Hugh Brinson search showed a 42-mile Midland lateral, not an Abilene lateral, and no Stargate link. Existing row P8318 (Hugh Brinson Abilene Laterals) may be the same supply but no source names this plant. Search budget ran out. Searches run: 4. Sources: TCEQ permit notice (on-site pressure-drop tap), mgrid.org VoltaGrid article (Oasis firm gas), Cleanview Stargate Frontier report (behind the meter, Oasis), BIC Magazine Hugh Brinson (no Abilene tie). Not reached: FERC, Railroad Commission GIS, county records, Energy Transfer decks.

evidence.note: TCEQ air permit 182467, VoltaGrid ABI-1, fuel gas pressure drop from nearby pipeline
VoltaGrid and Oracle: Energy Transfer Oasis Pipeline firm gas
Stargate Frontier behind-the-meter, Energy Transfer supplier
